notes.title: v 1.1.0 released!
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]here is a (last) regular update, the changes: [/p][p]- complete rework of monsters sprite;[/p][p]- classes (and sub-classes) are limited to 1 type of offhand, bodygear, headgear;[/p][p]- all weapons, armors and ring are not available at the start in the shop, instead [/p][p]they are unlocked progressively every chapter passed;[/p][p]- lot of items removed in shop for game balance;[/p][p]- change characters starting Equipment;[/p][p]- rework enemies and bosses drop;[/p][p]- change difficulties (remove useless hidden difficulty);[/p][p]- three distincts difficulties instead of five,[/p][p]- chapter 17 Rework; [/p][p]- add three mode : original (get the 6 overpowered characters in the second part),[/p][p]balanced (don't get them but their subclasses rings instead),[/p][p]classic (get nothing in the second part);[/p][p]- greatly buff default classes divine skills damage;[/p][p]- nerf spell blade divine skill;[/p][p]- extra bosses are also available in the main zone after the epilogue;[/p][p]- complete rework of shop menu;[/p][p]- corrected steal skill bug;  [/p][p]- can reset characters, gold or level in extra zone;[/p][p]- slightly rework the script to fit with the new ennemies.[/p][p]
Farewell everyone,[/p][p]David Nguyen.[/p][p][/p][p]ps: the linux version and demo have been removed.[/p]

notes.title: Linux version released!!!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

after some works, Clarent Saga: Chronicles is now available on Linux!
This should make the game fit for Steam deck user!
Beware some of the plugins/features didn't make the cut:
Window help description mask the second character windows status,
battle effect such as dodge motion blur or healing afterglow are removed,
sometime animation are displayed after damage and death.

I have playtested it (on Ubuntu) and it is perfectly playable with minimum bugs and lag.
Still the windows version is the best one so use it if you can.

Thank you for your support,
David Nguyen.

ps: I may make an android version and put it in the google play store too!
Next games of the Clarent Saga are on the making! Due to personal reason,
Clarent Saga: 8-bit RPG is currently on hold. I have hired someone to make Clarent Saga: Mana 
(an Action RPG). I hope this one don't need revision/edit so I can put it on Steam
directly!

notes.title: Some small error but no update for now...
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

After playing the game again, I came across some design errors.

When the game starts, you have to choose your difficulty. When choosing, if you cancel the difficulty is not initialized. All the variables are at 0 and the switches are off. In short, in this mode you don't gain xp or gold, and you don't heal between fights. I don't think you can go very far in the game like that but it's a good easter egg (a hidden difficulty!) so I think I'll leave it. And if a player does it by mistake, it's easy to change the difficulty back later.

Second mistake, the battlebacks are not in the right resolution, which compress them. But after playing again a bit, it's not especially noticeable. So I won't update the game soon,

Thank you for your support,
David Nguyen.

notes.title: About the future of Clarent Saga
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

here are some news regarding Clarent Saga.

Clarent Saga Tactics II is only an idea project
but I guess it will remain as such. I am running out of ideas,
energy and ressources. I will keep improving/updating the 
first one instead (if I can).

Concerning Clarent Saga: Chronicles,
I wish there is more sale (I sold around a hundred copies)
but it is alright.
I will still participate in the maximum number of 
steam sales, the greatest discount was -40% and I will
accelerate the rythm of discount.
The maximum amount of discount will be -70%.

In truth, I don't know if game creator is appropriate
as my role for this game, game conceptor may be more accurate.
Graphics, musics, battle system, script novel were (not done by me and)
only put together by me, and I did only supervise and ensure
the best game I could deliver.

When the game will reach -50% discount, I will make
a clarent saga bundle with the emperor tier dlc
of Clarent Saga Tactics (4.99$) and Clarent Saga Chronicles (9.99$)
at -50%. I will add more games to the bundle. See below.

The big news: I am announcing the next game in the Clarent Saga!
Clarent Saga: 8-bit RPG! I hired someone more skilled than me
with RPG Maker MV, I made the game concept and I will supervise it.
The game should be completed at the end of this month but
I will still need to check everything and playtest.

Finally I have an idea/concept for an action-RPG but game development will
start only after this one is released!

Thank you for your support,
David Nguyen.

notes.title: v 0.93 released! And some news...
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

here is a regular update, the changes:
add script up to chapter 19 (out of 22),
reworks credits,
revert and rebalance some skills.

Thank you for your support,
David Nguyen.

First I would like to say that the script is available up to 
ch20 but I didn't have time to implement it (sorry!). Bits of 
ch21 is also done, so the end of early access is near! I am 
very pleased with the writing of Faenon (the writer), he managed 
to understand what I wanted to offer with this game. The game isn't 
selling that well (<100 copies) but that was expected. I think once I 
am done with this game, I will stop making new games. While it
was fun, it was so time and energy consuming and became quite an 
obsession. But that's not the "end", if I can improve and update my 
two game available on Steam, don't worry I will. I invested more money 
than making it for now. Note that this game will slowly cost less and 
less on sale up to -70% for those who are patient! If you are still undecided, 
try the demo, it's free! I will be on holiday and take a break from this project. 
Good holiday and happy christmas/new year to all!

notes.title: About Steam sales.
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I would like to clarify the amount of discount during Steam sales.
First I will participate to as many Steam sales I can.
Right now the discounts are -10%. Every six months I will add 10%,
so after July 2, the discount will be -20%.
After 1 year (so the approximate end of early access), it will be -30%.
And so on, the maximum discount will be -60%.

For those with patience you can wait for the final product,
or support me by buying it now. If you played my previous game (Clarent Saga Tactics), 
you know that I will work on this until I deliver the best game I can.

Thank you for your support,
David Nguyen.

ps: I have other idea for a last Clarent Saga game, but I need to finish this one first.
